tasks.short: Arrange and maintain optical merchandise displays

steps.what: Arrange and maintain displays of optical merchandise for customer viewing

tasks.design: Retain physical display arrangement, replenishment and upkeep. Existing merchandising guidance in {DOCS} may inform the layout, but clinical automation tools do not move, clean or present optical merchandise.
tasks.previous_blocker: Displays require physical handling and judgement about actual space and presentation.
tasks.enabler_now: No relevant validated display-maintenance replacement is supplied.
tasks.still_hard: Keeping the display usable and appealing as customers handle merchandise and stock changes.
tasks.human_edge: Notice the actual condition and presentation of merchandise in the shop.
tasks.altitude: Display work and retail judgement remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Optical merchandise display work is physical and situational; the digest's clinical technologies do not establish a display labour saving.

assumptions: Boundary is physical merchandise arrangement and upkeep, excluding inventory purchasing, price administration and patient care. No separate administrative step is assumed.

Optician produces the display through retained physical work; shop manager supplies any existing merchandising guidance. No structured display-condition flag or automatic stock-location input is assumed.
Use native merchandising guidance first. No introduced workflow or system creates incremental upkeep.
research_questions: Which display activities require physical handling regardless of available planning software?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Physical arrangement and maintenance retain full time; no inventory-reporting baseline is invented.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Optical merchandise display work remains hands-on.
reach: Discuss accessible customer-facing presentation with patient representatives
role.ambitious_version: A dispensing optician who maintains clear, usable merchandise displays alongside their separately assessed optical care work.
